summary: Scage Future (Nasdaq: SCAG), a PRC zero-emission heavy-duty commercial vehicle maker, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release providing a business update and recap of Nasdaq listing compliance status. The ADSs remain listed on the Nasdaq Global Market. The company disclosed a June 11, 2026 minimum bid price notice with compliance through December 8, 2026; August 27, 2026 notices on Market Value of Listed Securities and Market Value of Publicly Held Shares, each through February 23, 2027; and audit committee composition notice with remediation through December 22, 2026. No immediate delisting results, but failure to regain compliance could prompt delisting—a going-concern and timing risk.
